replace.title: Replace {name}
replace.subtitle: The skill keeps its name and its place in your list. What it does will come from the file you upload.
replace.nameRule: A bundle declares a name in SKILL.md, and it has to be {name} — a skill keeps its name when its content is replaced. A .md or .txt file declares nothing, so any filename will do.

replace.createdInstead: Added as a new skill. {name} is unchanged.
replace._note: Nothing here mentions the previous version, and nothing here ever should. The old revision IS kept server-side, but no surface lists or restores one and none is planned — a sentence about getting the old file back would be a door with no room behind it. If that ever changes, the reassurance goes in subtitle, in every locale at once.

edit.frontmatterLocked: The frontmatter is saved exactly as it is. The name identifies this skill, so changing it means uploading a file instead.
edit.bundleUnavailable: This skill has files beside SKILL.md, so it is changed by replacing the whole bundle rather than edited here.
edit.discardBody: The edits you made to these instructions will be lost.
edit.sharedBody: There is one copy of this skill. Saving changes what it does for every bot below, and in your own list.
edit.sharedIncomplete: Some bots couldn’t be checked, so this list may be short.
edit.tryAdded: {name} is selected. Send a message to try it — any skills you already had selected are still on.

edit._note: sharedTitle is only ever shown for more than one bot — the dialog is suppressed at one or none, where the warning would be noise. Do not translate it as a singular.
